name: google-tasks-quick-add
title: Google Tasks Quick Add
description: Add Google Tasks in plain English, like "buy boots tomorrow", and tick them off from Raycast.
author: jenusan

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.subtitle: Google Tasks
commands.description: Type a task with an optional date or time, e.g. "submit report friday" or "SSHS 10am-12pm tomorrow", and press Enter.

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: Google Tasks
commands.description: Add a task with a live due-date preview, notes and a choice of list.

commands.name: my-tasks
commands.title: My Tasks
commands.subtitle: Google Tasks
commands.description: See your tasks grouped by due date, and complete or delete them.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Google OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: The iOS-type OAuth client ID from Google Cloud (bundle ID com.raycast). See the README.
